name: Shadow Stalker
body:
A shadow stalker uses the powers of the plane of shadow to make them deadly hunters and combatants. They can create shadow simulacrums of themselves to distract and combat their foes.

Class Features
Shadow Double (Sp)

At 1st level, a shadow stalker can conjure a shadowy quasi-real copy of themself from the shadow plane as a full-round action. This shadow double remains in their square, mimicking their movements as a single mirror image, except that it lasts until it is destroyed or they choose to dismiss it as a swift action. This ability does not stack with the mirror image spell or with similar abilities, such as the copycat ability of the Trickery domain. At 5th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, the shadow stalker gains an additional double.

Starting at 3rd level, the shadow stalker can move their shadow doubles as part of their own move action, the movement being split between the shadow stalker and their doubles. When outside of their square, the shadow doubles do not provide the mirror image protection to the shadow stalker. The shadow doubles can provide flanking and can make one attack per turn using the shadow stalker’s highest attack bonus plus the shadow stalker’s Intelligence modifier. If the attack hits it deals 1d6 damage plus the shadow stalker’s Intelligence modifier at 6th level and every 3rd level thereafter, the attack deals an additional 1d6 damage (to a maximum of 6d6 at 18th level). The damage is of the same type as the weapon the duplicate is wielding. This attack can be made even from the shadow stalker’s own square. Each shadow duplicate can move independently, as a group, or with the shadow stalker, though the movement gets split between any non-shadow-stalker-connected duplicate and the duplicates only get one attack per round regardless of the number of duplicates there are.

The shadow duplicate cannot benefit from nor be treated as possessing teamwork feats or special abilities that enhance the flanking they provide. When separated from the shadow stalker, the duplicate is destroyed if hit by an attack roll or any other area-of-effect damage. The AC of the shadow double is equal to the shadow stalker’s touch AC and it has CMD and saves equal to the shadow stalkers. The shadow duplicates benefit from the shadow stalker’s evasion, improved evasion, uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge if possessed. Any mind-affecting effect that target’s the shadow duplicate targets the shadow stalker instead, though the shadow stalker is not affected twice on the same effect.

After 6th level, aside from attacking and providing flanking, the shadow duplicates can perform any task that an unseen servant can perform except that they have an effective Strength score of 10. This ability replaces combat tactics and advanced tactics.

Shadow Invisibility (Sp)

Starting at 4th level, once per day the shadow stalker can use the spell invisibility as a spell-like ability when in an area of dim light or darker using their class level as their caster level. If the shadow stalker enters an area of bright light, the invisibility ends. While the shadow stalker is invisible with this ability, their shadow duplicates, if active, remain visible. The shadow stalker gets an additional use of this ability at 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 4th level.

Spell Use: At 7th level, the shadow stalker can use spell completion and spell trigger items as an arcane caster for 0th through 4th level spells from the following: spells from the illusion school from the wizard spell list, spells with the darkness descriptor, spells that create a silence, mist or fog effect, or that conjure quasi-real creatures like phantom steed. In addition, they can do so for the spell shadow walk. The shadow stalker uses their class level for the caster level and their Intelligence modifier for the spellcasting modifier if applicable. At 19th level, this extends to all spells with the shadow and darkness descriptors regardless of spell level. This ability replaces the 2nd combat tactic gained at 7th level and the 4th combat tactic gained at 19th level.

Shadow Mist Form (Sp)

At 13th level, a shadow stalker can transform into an inky black cloud of mist. This functions as gaseous form, except it also obscures vision as fog cloud. The shadow stalker can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to their class level. These minutes need not be consecutive but must be used in 1-minute increments. This ability replaces the 3rd combat tactic gained at 13th level.

Unfettered Shadows (Su)

At 20th level, as a standard action a shadow stalker can unfetter all of their shadow doubles for 1 minute. While unfettered, each shadow double can move and attack as if it were the shadow stalker without using any of his actions. A creature struck by a shadow double can attempt a Will save (DC 20 + the shadow stalker’s Intelligence modifier) each time it takes damage to recognize the illusion. If it succeeds, the target treats all the shadow doubles as 20% real, as the spell shadow conjuration. The shadow doubles cannot use the shadow double ability. The shadow stalker can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Intelligence modifier. This ability replaces tactical mastery.
